_doc: Estimation-universe filtration thresholds (Phase 2 funnel; see docs/universe-diagnostics-plan.md). The pre-filter population is the point-in-time S&P 500. Every threshold here is shown in the dashboard panel so the criteria are documented, not hidden. Defaults seed from the values already implicit in barra_build_frames and are deliberately loose - the S&P 500 is already curated, so a near-flat funnel is the expected, correct result (per Chris).
